Class RepositoryProvenance

java.lang.Object
network.ike.tooling.buildreport.RepositoryProvenance
public final class RepositoryProvenance extends Object
Answers the question a repository finding raises and the resolver event cannot: whose repository is this?

Maven 4 disambiguates remote repositories by appending a SHA-1 of the effective repository definition to the declared id, so a resolver event names spring-release-e22ad65b… rather than spring-release. That id is opaque, and — because the hash covers the URL and policies — it also changes whenever an upstream POM edits the repository, silently orphaning any ledger entry keyed on it. Findings therefore key on the declared id with the hash stripped, and carry the full id and URL as context instead.

Provenance is resolved at session end rather than at observation time: repository events fire before most POMs have been read, and the declarations come from ModelObservations, which the model observer fills throughout the build.

      public static String declaredId(String repositoryId)
      Strips Maven 4's disambiguation suffix from a repository id.

      repositoryId - the id as the resolver reported it; may be null

    • enrich

      public static List<Finding> enrich(List<Finding> findings, List<ModelObservations.FileModel> observations, List<Path> resolvedPoms, Path localRepository, Path executionRoot)
      Adds a Finding.CONTEXT_DECLARED_BY entry to every repository finding whose repository can be traced to a POM read during the session.
      Parameters:
      findings - the session's findings, in observation order
      observations - the session's file-model observations, which cover this workspace's POMs
      resolvedPoms - the dependency POMs the session resolved, which cover everything else
      localRepository - the local repository's base directory, which anchors a resolved POM's group id; may be null
      executionRoot - the session's execution root, used to say whether a declaring POM is in this workspace
      Returns:
      the findings, repository ones enriched where possible
